cs.t: Why are speakers so hard? It's insanely old technology and they're still charging hundreds for a baseline handheld speaker. I'm dearly holding onto my Marshall Acton that can be connect to WiFi without an app and stream directly from Spotify. No smart nothing. Nothing like this seems to exist anymore, not for the $200 I paid this years ago anyway. Before this I had tried a smaller but $250 Sonos speaker and it sounded like crap, with far worse UX.
